hero.subtitle: A collision on the I-10 or along Azusa Avenue can leave you sorting out medical bills, a damaged car and calls from an insurer all at once. LawProactive connects West Covina residents, at no cost, with an independent car accident attorney who can take that weight off your shoulders.

about.title: West Covina Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Traffic through West Covina moves in layers. The I-10 San Bernardino Freeway carries commuters across the top of the city, while Azusa Avenue, Sunset Avenue and Amar Road handle the local trips to school and work. In 2025, public records show 409 injury collisions in West Covina, with 573 people injured and 5 lives lost. Those numbers are simply counts, but each one represents someone whose week, or year, changed in a moment. Reports also show crashes clustering on Wednesdays between 3 p.m. and 5 p.m., when afternoon traffic builds along the arterials. If you were hurt in one of these collisions, LawProactive can help you take the next step without cost. We are not a law firm. We are a free service that connects people in Los Angeles County with an independent personal injury attorney who handles car accident claims on contingency, meaning no fee unless there is a recovery. You tell us what happened; the attorney explains your options under California law, from the two-year filing window to how comparative fault might apply.

whyChoose.title: Why West Covina Drivers Turn to LawProactive

items.title: The clock is already running
items.desc: California gives most car accident victims two years to file a lawsuit, but if a city vehicle or a road maintained by a public agency played a role, that window can shrink to six months. The attorney you're connected with can pin down which deadline applies to you before it becomes a problem.

items.title: Partial fault does not close the door
items.desc: Under California's pure comparative fault rule, you can still recover even if you were partly responsible, with your share reduced by your percentage of blame. An attorney can push back when an insurer tries to inflate that percentage.

items.title: No fee unless you recover
items.desc: Every attorney in our network works on contingency, so you pay nothing up front and nothing at all unless your claim results in a recovery. Our connection service is free as well, and there's no cap in California on compensation for pain, suffering and lost quality of life.

items.question: I was rear-ended on the I-10 near the Azusa Avenue exit. Should I talk to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: You are not required to give the other driver's insurer a recorded statement, and it is generally wise to decline until you have spoken with an attorney. Adjusters are trained to ask questions that can later be used to shift some of the blame onto you, which matters under California's comparative fault system. Report the crash to your own insurer as your policy requires, and let an attorney handle communication with the other side.

items.question: What evidence should I gather after a West Covina car crash?
items.answer: Photos of the vehicles, the roadway and any visible injuries are valuable, as are the names of witnesses and the responding officers' report number. Keep every medical record, receipt and repair estimate, and save the damaged parts of your car if you can. Many stretches of Azusa Avenue, Sunset Avenue and Amar Road are lined with businesses whose cameras may have captured the collision, and that footage is often overwritten within days, so acting quickly helps.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge for connecting me with an attorney?
items.answer: No. Our service is completely free, and we are not a law firm ourselves. The independent attorney you are connected with works on a contingency basis, which means there is no fee unless your case results in a recovery. You can ask questions and decide whether to move forward with no obligation.
